newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Savoy's offer to buy New Star shrs oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Savoy's offer to buy New Star shrs oversubscribed.

text.p: Seoul-based Savoy Hotel's tender offer to buy New Star Trading shares had been 2.1 times subscribed, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Thursday.
Savoy earlier offered to buy 148,592 shares or 30.51 percent of New Star's common stock to increase its stake to 51.21 percent from the current 20.70 percent.
The board said in a statement that Savoy, which wanted to take over New Star to diversify its business, would buy the stake at 65,500 won per share.
The stock closed at 57,000 won on Thursday.
The purchase would be South Korea's first hostile takeover of a listed company.
The board said the president of New Star and his relatives also offered to sell some of their shares.
